description.value: Au Comptoir is a French bistro in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood, co-founded by French expatriates Maxime Bettilli and Julien Aubin to bring classic bistro culture to the Pacific Northwest. Chef Alexandre Carrière leads a kitchen that changes its menus seasonally, drawing on local producers and classical French technique to serve everything from morning coffee to multi-course dinners. The restaurant has earned consistent recognition from Vancouver media and award bodies for its French cuisine and brunch.
